{"thought": "語意層與 schema 已確認定義：準時為配送天數 ≤ 3 天、分母為已送達出貨、期間依訂單成立時間歸屬，物流商代碼為 blackcat。時間欄位是 TEXT，先抽樣看格式再計算。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT s.shipment_id, s.carrier, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, o.order_ts, o.status FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.carrier = 'blackcat' LIMIT 10", "SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS undelivered FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier"]}}

response: {"thought": "依語意層定義，準時 = 配送天數（送達 − 出貨）≤ 3 天，分母只含已送達出貨，期間依訂單成立時間落在 2025 年第一季。先計算結果並同時檢查是否有送達早於出貨等異常資料。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_n, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts) <= 3.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_n, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts) <= 3.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS on_time_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(s.delivered_ts) < julianday(s.shipped_ts) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_days_n, MIN(o.order_ts) AS min_order_ts, MAX(o.order_ts) AS max_order_ts FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.carrier = 'blackcat' AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND o.order_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < '2025-04-01'"}}
